primary_corrections_to_draft: 1215 covering letter survives; only its enclosed essay is missing, with a Strickland abstract in footnote 6.
1232 is an outgoing Darwin letter. Its diagrams cannot be labeled incoming prompt content.

Direction is schema-specific: reply edges use response and antecedent; direct-pair fields use incoming and outgoing. Do not blanket-reverse all relationships.

verification.method: Primary substantive review against accepted full-source readings, targeted rereading of relevant original footnotes and raw DOM, and exact hash validation. Requirements do not certify implemented conversion.
